<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt"><U>Item&nbsp;7.01. Regulation&nbsp;FD Disclosure.</U>
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">On 23 September&nbsp;2005, the company published Current Business Information, including
consolidated sales and product volumes for July and August&nbsp;2005, on its website at
<U>http://www.airproducts.com/Invest/financialnews/current.htm</U>. A copy of the Current
Business Information dated September&nbsp;23, 2005 is attached as Exhibit&nbsp;99.1 to this Form 8-K.
This Current Business Information is being furnished; it is not deemed to be filed.
